And roughly a year after its release, the ''Timelines'' fiction made the big reveal that yes, this was the villainous incarnation. He also comes with the longsword accessory from the ''Kre-O Dungeons & Dragons'' series, possibly in a bid to represent the sword wielded by his above ''Timelines'' toy. : He also uses the updated 2015-style Kreon body, making almost all of his parts incompatible with previous years' Kreons. : He was only available in the "[[Kreon Class of '85]]" 30-Kreon box set, a [[San Diego Comic-Con]] 2015 [[exclusive]], also sold online through [[Hasbro Toy Shop]] following the convention. ::*''[http://www.tfu.info/2015/Autobot/SDCCKre-OAlphaTrion/alphatrion.htm More information on Class of '85 Alpha Trion at TFU.info]'' {{--}} ===''Legends''=== [[File:Legendstoy-LG14-Alpha Trion.jpg|upright=1.66|thumb|So I'm basically Optimus Prime's brother ''and'' father figure?]]

:*''ID number'': '''LG-14''' :*''Release date'': [[2015]] [[September 9]] {{toydesigner|[[Marcelo Matere]] (packaging artist)}} : The ''[[Transformers Legends (franchise)|Legends]]'' release of ''[[Combiner Wars (toyline)|Combiner Wars]]'' Leader Class [[Ultra Magnus (G1)/toys#Legends|Ultra Magnus]] includes a small Alpha Trion figure, which is a redeco of the [[Minimus Ambus#Toys|Minimus Ambus]] figure (as Minimus does not appear in any Japanese-original fiction). In robot mode, Alpha Trion can sit inside Ultra Magnus's robot mode torso, "wearing" the Magnus head like a helmet. {{--}} ===''Titans Return''=== [[File:TF-Generations-Titans-Return-Voyager-Alpha-Trion.jpg|upright=1.66|thumb|Destined to be repurposed as [[Cheetor (BW)#Wings Universe|Alpha Trizer]].]]

:*''Accessories:'' Sword, [[Sovereign#Toys|Sovereign]] Titan Master, Gun {{toydesigner|[[John Warden]] (Hasbro)|[[Emiliano Santalucia]] (concept artist), [[Marcelo Matere]] and [[Robby Musso]] (packaging art)}} :''[[Titans Return (toyline)|Titans Return]]'' Alpha Trion is the first transforming toy of the character to be released at mass retail, and the first to be designed with Alpha Trion in mind from the beginning. Like all ''Titans Return'' Voyager figures, he is a [[Triple Changer]], with spring-loaded adornments that bulk out his [[Titan Master]] head at the push of a button (in his case, the transparent crystal in his chest). Both his alternate modes are references to Alpha Trion's previous BotCon toys: the [[#Expanded Universe|unproduced lion]] from [[3H Productions]], and the [[#Timelines|spaceship]] from [[Fun Publications]]. In fact, the circular detail on the toy's chest and the intricate surfaces thus originate with [[Vector Prime]]'s design, rather than Alpha Trion's cartoon appearance; it's also possible that the sweeping silver curves on his chest, the sword, and upwards orientation of the lion paws are inspired by [[Cheetor (BW)/toys#BotCon2014|Alpha Trizer]], though none of the details are a definitive match. His Titan master [[Sovereign]] is sculpted in homage to [[Beta Maxx (RID)|Beta Maxx]], who in turn was a [[redeco]] of [[Safeguard (Cybertron)|Safeguard]]. :Alpha Trion's sword forms the tail of the lion mode, slotting into a bespoke connection point. In an [[Instructions#Undocumented features|undocumented feature]], the triple-barreled gun (which, as usual, has a seat for a Titan Master) can also stow away in this mode, using slots to attach to a pair of tabs atop the transparent cockpit. The toy has a [[5 mm post|5 mm port]] on the back of each shoulder and on the back of the waist, along with a 3 mm port for a [[flight stand]]. :The Hasbro Asia exclusive giveaway sticker sheet can be used to enhance the figure's details.https://news.tfw2005.com/2016/09/23/hasbro-asia-titans-return-stickers-wave-2-325179 :In Canada and Australia, Alpha Trion along with his wavemate [[Astrotrain (G1)/toys#Titans Return|Astrotrain]] were prominent shelfwarmers, while finding Alpha Trion anywhere in the US was a great deal more difficult. :Alpha Trion is a [[Retool#Shared parts|pretool]] of ''Titans Return'' [[Broadside (G1)#Titans Return|Broadside]], sharing various parts—most obviously the front of the aircraft-carrier mode, which becomes the front of Alpha Trion's spaceship mode. However, the toy has an amount of distinct tooling that was nigh-unprecedented at the time, with the second alternate mode being completely different. Broadside was in turn retooled with a new face as ''Titans Return'' [[Tidal Wave (G1)#Titans Return|Tidal Wave]]. :This toy was [[Repurposing|repurposed]] as a body for ''[[Transformers: Shattered Glass (franchise)|Shattered Glass]]'' [[Alpha Trion#Shattered Glass|Alpha Trion]]. This mold was retooled with a new face as ''[[Transformers Legends (franchise)|Legends]]'' [[Lio Convoy (BW)#Legends|Leo Prime]]. The sword was redecoed into ''Legends'' [[Magna Convoy]]'s [[Matrix Sword]] and ''[[War for Cybertron: Siege|Siege]]'' [[Nemesis Prime (G1)#War for Cybertron: Siege|Nemesis Prime]]'s Ancient Sword. {{--}} ===''Power of the Primes''=== [[File:TF-POTP-Prime-Master-Alpha-Trion-with-Landmine.jpg|upright=1.66|thumb|''Legends'', ''Titans Return'', ''Power of the Primes''. The trilogy is complete!]]

:*''TakaraTomy name:'' '''Alpha Trion''' (アルファトライオン) :*''TakaraTomy ID number:'' '''PP-32''' :*''TakaraTomy release date'': [[2018]] [[October 27]] :*''Accessories:'' Landmine decoy armor, cannon {{toydesigner|[[John Warden]] (Hasbro)|[[Robby Musso]] (packaging artist)}} :''[[Power of the Primes (toyline)|Power of the Primes]]'' Alpha Trion is a [[Prime Master]] with [[Landmine (G1)#Power of the Primes|Landmine]] decoy armor, visually based on the original [[Pretender]]'s shell. Alpha Trion/Landmine is a [[retool]] of [[Vector Prime#Power of the Primes|Vector Prime]]/[[Metalhawk (G1)#Power of the Primes|Metalhawk]], with a new [[Prime Master]] sigil and decoy armor front. :This toy has identical features to the other Prime Masters in the line. The decoy armor has a weapon piece which can fold out to create a weapon mode, or detach and be held in the armor's 3 mm-compatible hand. The [[Titan Master]]-like robot can store inside the decoy armor or ride [[Size class|Legends Class]] figures in vehicle mode, and is fully compatible with toys from the previous ''[[Titans Return (toyline)|Titans Return]]'' line. The "Power Swap" gimmick means its [[spark]] form can plug onto any decoy armor's weapon form (which has a [[5 mm post]] to be held by larger figures), Deluxe Class figures' chest armor, Voyager Class figures' bucklers, Leader Class figures' [[Matrix of Leadership/toys#Power of the Primes|Matrix]] (in place of their Matrix core), [[combiner]]s' torsos (in place of their [[Enigma of Combination]]), or the [[Scepter of Sparks]]. With the power of [[you]]r imagination, this bestows the Prime Master's [[Prime Master/Combinations|unique power]] on the larger figure. :Quality control on the Landmine armor varies: many units' arm holes are slightly too small, warping the connector joints in-package and making the arms pop off when posing. Copies with normal-sized holes can be identified by viewing the package sideways to see whether the joints are warped. There have also been some reports of copies with just one flawed arm. {{--}} ===''Cyberverse''=== [[File:CV-toy AlphaTrion.jpg|thumb|upright=1.66|Not content with merely stealing Thunderblast's kibble, Alpha Trion escalated to stealing her alternate mode. Next up, her credit card number.]]

:*''Action Attack'': "Laser Beam Blast" :Released in the fourth wave of ''[[Transformers: Cyberverse (toyline)|Cyberverse]]'' Ultra class figures, under the ''Power of the Spark'' banner, Alpha Trion transforms into a Cybertronian starship. Pressing a button on the rear of the ship mode causes a molded, non-removable double "Laser Beam Blast" effect to flip out of each wing. The mechanism does not lock in too well, so the laser blasts are prone to deploying all the time in this mode. : The flaps on his legs that form the spaceship nose are even more prone to popping off, especially when they get in the way of posing his limited legs. Alpha Trion only features outward moving articulation at his shoulders and hips, making his knees difficult to employ meaningfully, leaving his elbows as the only useful point of articulation. Just like a real old person. {{--}} ===''Legacy''=== [[File:Legacy-toy AlphaTrion.jpg|thumb|upright=1.66|"Please, [[Optimus Prime (G1)/Generations toys#HasbroPulse|my son]], he is very sick..."]]

:*''Accessories'': Rifle, [[Vector Sigma#Legacy|Vector Sigma]], [[Key to Vector Sigma#Legacy|Key to Vector Sigma]], stand {{toydesigner|[[Evan Brooks]] (Hasbro), [[Takio Ejima]] and [[Takashi Kunihiro]] (TakaraTomy)|[[Lenny Panzica]] (initial concept)}}[https://youtu.be/vuZHDR3ZBd8 Transformers Panel] at [[Hasbro Pulse Con 2022]] Day 1 on the [[Hasbro Pulse]] YouTube channel. : Revealed at [[San Diego Comic-Con]] 2022, ''[[Transformers: Legacy|Legacy]]'' Alpha Trion is a hefty [[retool]] of ''[[Studio Series]]'' [[Scourge (G1)/toys#Studio Series|Scourge]], transforming into a Cybertronian hovercraft in 21 steps. This release uses new "wing" pieces in robot mode to resemble his cape from the original animation model; unfortunately, due to clearance issues with his new chest, those pieces do not fold up neatly into the vehicle mode undercarriage, so they just kind of sit there awkwardly and make him tilt forward when placed on a flat surface. Alpha Trion also utilizes two newly sculpted [[5 mm post]]-compatible open-palm hands with rounded fingertips rather than having either of the previous molds' pointy and asymmetrical open/closed hand arrangements. : Alpha Trion was only available in the "A Hero Is Born" two-pack with [[Optimus Prime (G1)/Generations toys#Legacy|Orion Pax]], as well as a Vector Sigma accessory and the Key to Vector Sigma. The set went up for pre-order during [[Hasbro Pulse Con 2022|Pulse Con 2022]], and began appearing at stores in Hong Kong shortly afterward. : [[Taiwan]]ese fans who supported the [[Hasbro Pulse|HasLab]] [[Star Saber (G1)#Legacy|Victory Saber]] project ended up getting the "A Hero Is Born" set instead (along with a full refund) after their Victory Sabers were severely water damaged during shipment and could not be delivered. No, this set is nowhere near as cool. Sorry?{{citesocial|quote=People in Taiwan that preordered Haslab Victory Saber through Hasbro TW is getting their preorders cancelled because their batch had too much water damage during transport to be rendered acceptable. They're getting a full refund and a free Alpha Trion set to compensate. (2022) https://t.co/h2A26ZDcS0|link=https://twitter.com/TF_Moments/status/1570857553503948800/photo/1|name=Crazy ass moments in Transformers History|site=Twitter|year=2022|month=09|day=16|(defunct=)}} : This mold was also retooled into [[Ratbat (G1)/toys#Legacy|Senator Ratbat]]. {{-}} ===''One''=== {{anchor|PrimeChanger}} [[File:Prime_Changers_Alpha_Trion.jpg|thumb|upright=1.66|Genderbent [[Twilight Sparkle]].]]

:*''TakaraTomy name:'' '''Deluxe Class Alpha Trion''' (デラックスクラス アルファトライオン) :*''TakaraTomy ID number:'' '''OD-02''' :*''TakaraTomy release date'': [[2024]] [[July 13]] :*''Accessories:'' Energon tail whip, Energon dagger/horn :Released as part of the [[Transformers One (toyline)|''Transformers One'']] Prime Changers line, Alpha Trion is roughly Deluxe Class-sized and is cast almost entirely in pearlescent plastic, and almost all of his paint applications (except on his weapons) use metallic or glittery paint. He transforms from a robot to a horned lion in 15 steps with his tail and horn being wielded as weapons in robot mode. They can be stored inside the "cape" formed from the halves of his beast-mode head. There is a 3 mm flight stand port on the back of his pelvis, though it is blocked off in beast mode by his tail. {{-}}{{anchor|RobotBattlers}} [[File:Robot_Battlers_Alpha_Trion.jpg|thumb|upright=1.66|Neither giant nor a [[Giant Purple Griffin|griffin]], but it'll have to do.]]

:*''Accessories:'' Energon tail whip, Energon dagger/horn, base : Released as part of the Robot Battlers line, Alpha Trion transforms from a robot into a robotic horned lion. Instead of an Energon sword like other Robot Battlers, Alpha Trion's weapons are his detachable tail and horn. The figure can be placed on a base to perform action moves by sliding the finger slots to knock an opponent's figure off of their base.

:*''TakaraTomy name:'' '''Alpha Trion''' (アルファトライオン) :*''TakaraTomy ID number:'' '''AOTP-20''' :*''TakaraTomy release date:'' [[2025]] [[December 27]] :*''Accessories'': [[Quill#Age of the Primes|Quill]], [[Covenant of Primus#Age of the Primes|"Covenant book"]], shield, [[Coder Remote|Autobot insignia]], 2 shoulder pad nubs {{toydesigner|[[Mark Maher]] (Hasbro), [[Shogo Hasui]] (TakaraTomy)}}[[June 10]], [[2025]]'s [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KEAkXHAU034 Transformers Fanstream | June 2025 | Hasbro Pulse] on YouTube, with [[Nate Purswell]] and [[Mark Maher]]. :Part of the third wave of ''[[Transformers: Age of the Primes|Age of the Primes]]'' Voyagers, Alpha Trion transforms from a robot based heavily on his younger-than-usual appearance in the [[The Transformers (cartoon)|Generation 1 cartoon]] flashback episode "[[War Dawn (episode)|War Dawn]]" to a spaceship resembling [[:File:ImAlphaTrionsHovercraftMode.jpg|an unused alternate mode]] created for his [[2005 IDW continuity|2005 IDW]] comic incarnation. The spaceship features an opening cockpit, in which a [[Titan Master]] can be seated. While he lacks wrist swivels, he does have opening hands, a hinge below his neck swivel that allows him to look up and down farther than most figures, and rare ab articulation thanks to a transformation hinge. His hands are ''slightly'' undersized, which can make getting accessories into them a tad annoying. :Alpha Trion comes with his two artifacts: the Quill and the Covenant of Primus, as well as a forearm-mounted shield and 2 removable shoulder pad spikes. The shield stores behind his waist like an extension of his cape, though this can limit his waist swivel. It can be [[fan mode|arranged differently]] to be less cumbersome. In vehicle mode it attaches underneath, forming the spaceship's fins and revealing a flight stand port. The Quill is [[5 mm post|5 mm compatible]] and can store on a narrow tab on either half of the shield. The Covenant book's cover is based on the [[:File:COPAlphaTrion.jpg|''Covenant of Primus'' artwork]] and includes two individual pages: the first reproduces its [[:File:Nemesis1 Rattrap holds up covenant.jpg|appearance]] in the [[Beast Wars: Transformers (cartoon)|''Beast Wars'']] cartoon with a [[tampograph]] of [[Cybertron (planet)|Cybertron]]; the second has the phrase "[['Til all are one]]" in [[Cybertronian language|Ancient Autobot]], signed off with Trion's personal emblem. The book features a 5 mm post molded on its front cover to allow Trion or other figures to hold it, and can also slot onto tabs on his forearms. The book stores on a port in his back and underneath his alternate mode. Lastly, The Autobot insignia on his torso is removable, representing the [[Coder Remote]] utilized by an even younger A-3 in the episode "[[Forever Is a Long Time Coming (episode)|Forever Is a Long Time Coming]]." As it also uses a 5 mm post, it can attach to other ports, such as swapping with the shoulder spikes as per the instructions. ::*''[https://www.instagram.com/p/DLi9iXqMTLp/ Designer commentary on ''Age of the Primes'' Alpha Trion from Mark Maher on Instagram]'' ::*''[[Source:Transformers Age of the Primes bios#AOTP20|Machine translation of Alpha Trion's TakaraTomy bio]]'' {{--}} ===''Studio Series''=== [[File:TF-SS-ONE-Voyager-Alpha-Trion.jpg|thumb|300px|Mmmm... mossy.]]

:*''Movie'': ''''' Transformers One''''' :*''TakaraTomy name:'' '''Alpha Trion''' (アルファトライオン) :*''TakaraTomy ID number'': '''TS-22''' :*''TakaraTomy release date'': [[May 30]], 2026 :*Accessories: tail whip, horn, 4 spikes {{toydesigner|[[Evan Brooks]] (Hasbro), [[Takio Ejima]] (TakaraTomy)}}[[June 24]], [[2025]]'s [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uaPi02SMMSo Transformers Studio Series Fanstream | June 2025 | Hasbro Pulse] on YouTube, with [[Nate Purswell]] and [[Evan Brooks]]. :Released as part of the first ''[[Studio Series]]'' wave of 2026, Alpha Trion is based on his appearance in ''Transformers One'', transforming into a horned lion. This is the first figure to be modeled after his decrepit present-day appearance, though notably the toy does add a left shoulder pad that is absent on the final design. Unlike the [[#One|Prime Changer toy]], he lacks his signature cape or a makeshift version of it, and lacks ankle joints for robot ''and'' beast modes, which can hamper posing. As is typical with contemporary beastformers, he has pegs that lock his beast shoulders into place; simply disconnecting them will allow more articulation. Those protruding pegs can interfere with some poses in both modes. :Like his prior ''One'' toys, Alpha Trion's energy tail becomes a whip for his robot mode. He includes his horn and 4 smaller spikes that go into his beast shoulders and hips using 5 mm ports. All 5 spikes are meant to be moved onto his tail whip in robot mode. As they can be easily lost, it may be best to leave the smaller spikes in which ever mode you prefer; unfortunately, [[partformer|partforming]] the horn is required unless you're fine with a hornless lion mode. Additionally, the tail whip can store on his behind in robot mode and the beast mode mouth can hold 5 mm accessories. :He, alongside [[Airachnid (One)#Studio Series|Airachnid]], was revealed in [[prototype]] form on the [[June 24]], [[2025]] fanstream, before being shown off in full color at that year's [[San Diego Comic-Con]], with pre-orders going live on [[September 17|"Transformers Day"]]. {{--}} ==Merchandise== ===''Super Collection Figure''=== [[File:SCF Alpha Trion.jpg|thumb|upright=1.66|You better believe people were excited for this in 2002.]] *'''Alpha Trin''' ([[2002]]) **''Act'': '''8''' **''Accessories'': Stand : The first "toy" of Alpha Trion ever made, this three-inch-tall [[plastic|PVC]] figurine was available in "Act 8" of [[TakaraTomy|Takara]]'s ''[[Heroes of Cybertron (toyline)|Super Collection Figure]]'' line. Like all the figures in the wave, it was available as both a standard full-color figure and a metallic-silver "pewter" version, one of each of which was available in a standard case of twelve [[blindpacking|blindpacked]] figures. : The pewter version of the figure has a potential problem with connector peg breakage, due to said pegs often getting a layer of pewter paint before being forced into a socket, leading to sticking and tearing. :*''Series:'' '''Galaxy Version 07 - One Wave 2''' :*''Pull rate'': 1/9 :*''Accessories:'' 2 pairs of hands (Fists/Weapon-holding, open palm), Energon tail-whip :Part of [[Blokees]]' 7th entry for their Galaxy Version blindbox kits, this Alpha Trion is a roughly 4-inch-tall, highly-articulated, and non-transforming snap-on model kit of the Prime Mentor. He is built on a "Standard Body" skeleton shared with other Blokees figures in the line, but with different body pieces to make them distinct. As advertised in the box, Alpha Trion has a pull rate of 1 in every 9 boxes. Aside from the 2 pairs of hands, he also comes with his 2-piece Energon Tail-whip. In addition, Alpha Trion features a ball-jointed waist similar to his wave mates, and he also uses the underslung peghole forearms from the 5th wave. :If you're a speed builder, be mindful when attaching the pre-assembled joints; Unlike the symmetrical joints from earlier waves, the pegs on both ends of these joints are designed to connect to specific pieces; The tabs with slightly smaller holes are intended for the upper arms and thighs, while the regular tabs are meant for the forearms and lower legs. While an incorrect knee joint assembly may cause it to very slightly lean when standing straight or in an A-stance, an incorrect elbow assembly won't be noticeably affected unless you're looking very closely. {{-}} ====Blokees Wheels==== [[File:Blokees-Wheels-TF-C03-Alpha-Trion.jpg|thumb|300px|'''Alpha Tri''dor''on''']]

:*''Series:'' '''Blokees Wheels Transformers 03 - Wreck'N Rule 2''' :*''Pull rate:'' 1/12 :*''Accessories'': Vector Sigma w/ removable key :Part of the third wave of the Blokees Wheels series of blind-boxed 1/64-scale vehicles, this Alpha Trion model kit is a unique entry in the line, as it is inspired by his rare land-based vehicle mode featured in IDW Publishing's [[Omega's Conundrum]] from the Dark Prelude chapter of the ''Dark Cybertron'' event. He uses the same universal Chassis Connector as the rest of the lineup, and his canopy can be opened to reveal a cockpit. Unfortunately, even with the cavity in the driver's seat, there isn't much space for a Blokees Driver to properly sit on. :Alpha Trion also comes with a two-piece trophy accessory consisting of the Vector Sigma and its removable key, though it cannot interact with any of the vehicles.
